messages:
tasha: Heads-up — PR #3284 for the dashboard schema migration has a failing sample render in the Console docs. Example JSON uses `traceId` but our runtime panels expect `trace_id`. It's causing the cost/latency breakdown to show empty traces.

miguel (Eng): which page? can you drop link? :mag:

tasha: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3284 — section: console/observability/dashboards/migration.md. Snippet at the bottom.

sam (DevX): saw the failing netlify preview earlier. linkcheck also flagged the dashboard example anchor. I can patch the snippet if you want.

laura (Eng): tagging @miguel — the runtime change was intentional to normalize snake_case in panel templates. We should update docs to match.

miguel (Eng): ok. can we also update the python/js SDK snippet? I noticed an inline example uses `trace` as the key when our SDK expects `trace_id` in the header payload.

tasha: yea that's another mismatch. Example currently:
```python
client.send_event("/generate", data={"prompt": p, "trace": trace_token})
```
should be
```python
client.send_event("/generate", data={"prompt": p, "trace_id": trace_token})
```
I'll add a small note about backwards compatibility.

docs-bot: build failed — sample-render job #512: dashboard panel JSON invalid (schema mismatch).

sam (DevX): I'll open a tiny PR to flip keys and add a redwood-compat note. Plan:
- fix snippet JSON keys
- fix python/js examples
- add migration note and an automated linkcheck test
- run netlify preview
Should be quick.

tasha: awesome. assign to sam. miguel, can you review the runtime side? just to confirm no other key renames pending.

miguel (Eng): on it, will review after standup. ping me @miguel if you push wip commits.

laura (Eng): also add a quick test snippet for the tracing hook showing `X-Trace-Id` header mapping to `trace_id` in panels. saves future confusion.

tasha: good call. thanks all :thumbsup:
